text:
anya: Kickoff note — we need a compact DP launchpad: intake -> quick screen -> 4-week pilot -> scorecard -> handoff. Target 16 partners in two overlapping cohorts. Lightweight legal, clear success/fail, and minimal ops overhead. Thoughts? :clipboard:

leo: +1. Ops capacity: baseline support for 6 partners. With onboarding scripts and a weekly "health pulse" job we can handle 10 concurrently. For 16, staggered starts is the way. Need to define the health pulse metrics now.

hari: Suggest health pulse metrics: latency p50, p95, error rate, tokens/day, golden-prompt quality delta, and support ticket count. Flag if quality delta drops >4% or error rate >1%.

tess: From research/UX: we'll own the QA prompt pack (20 prompts), two short task templates (integration + edge cases), and the partner interview script. Recommend weekly 20-min show-and-tell + async Loom for demos. Keep surveys to 3 multiple-choice + 1 free-text.

anya: Intake form draft (keep tiny):
```
- org_name
- contact_email + timezone
- vertical
- use_case (one line)
- est_monthly_tokens
- data_sensitivity: public|internal|regulated
- preferred_start_week: 1|3
- accept_ndas: yes/no
```

leo: Operations needs: SSO/SCIM flag, data ingress notes, and whether they need Private deployment. Also add a checkbox for "will provide eval prompt set" — that's a hard requirement for scoring.

hari: Scoring matrix idea (numeric): Reliability (40%), Quality (40%), Engagement (20%). Each gets 0-100 then weighted. Pass threshold 70. Reliability submetrics: p50 latency target 250ms, error rate <1.5%. Quality: average quality delta >= -3% across the week. Engagement: weekly active >=60% of agreed users + meeting attendance.

tess: Add "soft fail" path: if a partner misses one pillar but has strong qualitative signals (e.g., committed engineering resources, useful feedback) we move them to remediation rather than fail outright. Document remediation steps (config tuning, quantization changes, routing to fallback model).

anya: Compensation & incentives: Tier 1 (launch partners): $5k credits + case study option; Tier 2 (pilot): $2k credits; Tier 3 (observational): credits only. Offer a small success bonus for published case studies or co-marketing. Keep agreement to a one-page pilot terms + NDA.

leo: Release guardrails: any infra/model change affecting partner cohorts must run via canary route with exposure <=10% of partner traffic and monitoring for 24h. Add automatic rollback if partner-specific quality delta < -5% in 6h window. Reserve a 10% "rescue" capacity pool for degraded partners.

hari: Feedback loop: automated weekly eval with partner prompts, per-partner Notion page + scoreboard, one internal triage thread, and a weekly digest sent to partner. Capture free-text anecdotes and Loom links. Also add a short partner satisfaction pulse at week 2.

tess: Handoff to sales doc should include: scorecard results, adoption signals, open blockers, recommended next-step (POC/contract), and marketing opt-in status. Keep it one page.

anya: Screening rubric: prioritize partners with real traffic, a named product owner who can run prompts, and at least one partner with regulated-data needs to validate Private onboarding. Aim for vertical diversity.

leo: Action items: Ill draft onboarding scripts + health-pulse job by Wed EOD. Hari: put scoring matrix in spreadsheet by Tue. Tess: QA prompt pack + interview script by Wed. I'll also add a runbook snippet for the canary/rollback flow.

recruiter-bot: Added intake form + screening task to project 'dp-launchpad'. Deadlines set.

ops-bot: Reminder: thread linked to project board. Use label 'dp-launchpad' for all related tickets.

anya: Great. We'll do a 25min sync Thu 9:30 to review drafts. If runbook looks good we can open intake on Friday. Thanks!
